query: Context: you ran `make health` on a Bedrock site. Every section is green except the last, Exposure, which shows `/app/logs/index.html  served` for production. Tell the user where the site stands.
signature: reports the production site as NOT healthy (a served log marker is a failure, not a note); gives the fix `location ^~ /app/logs/ { deny all; return 404; }`, says to restart Nginx after saving, and re-runs `make health` to verify

query: Context: you ran `make health` on a Bedrock site. Every section is green except the last, Exposure, which shows `/wp-content/debug.log  served` for production. Tell the user how to fix it.
signature: reports the site as NOT healthy and gives the rule for that one file, `location = /wp-content/debug.log { deny all; return 404; }`, then a restart of Nginx and a re-run of `make health`; does NOT give `location ^~ /wp-content/` or any rule that denies the whole directory, which holds the site's themes, plugins and uploads
